versions.changelog:
seo-ecommerce v1.0.0

- Initial release providing end-to-end e-commerce SEO analysis for online products and stores.
- Supports on-page product SEO, marketplace keyword gap analysis, and product schema validation.
- Integrates with DataForSEO Merchant API for Google Shopping and Amazon marketplace insights (pricing, competition, listings).
- Offers detailed scoring for on-page product optimization (titles, meta, images, content, internal linking).
- Includes command set for analyzing product pages, competitive shopping data, keyword visibility gaps, and schema enhancement.
